observations.title: Rubidium (Embeddium) role and integration boundary
observations.player_action: Use the consuming mod's interface or feature; this component's own installation is not a survival objective.
observations.outcome: The installed Embeddium archive declares this as a compatibility stub for mods checking the Rubidium ID; it is not evidence of a second independently installed terrain renderer.
conditions: Exact installed artifact metadata was inspected; current author pages can cover newer versions.
No runtime behavior or benchmark was verified; do not change installed configuration from these research notes.
User policy 2026-10-22: never install the standalone Rubidium mod; user reports it crashes this pack. The embedded Embeddium compatibility ID is not permission to add a Rubidium JAR.
observations.review_note: Installed static role is corroborated by the artifact/resource/SHA256 attached to the source. Public URL identifies the upstream project, not a claim that a missing web guide was read. Multiple packaged versions remain loader-resolution candidates: 0.7.1 No standalone Rubidium artifact was installed or recommended during this research.
